description: Application log lines from the backend SDK, newest first, or counts with group_by. Use it to see what happened around an error: pass trace_id for one request's lines, or q and level to search. Lines are kept 14 days, and the default range is the last 24 hours.

group_by.description: Counts per value instead of lines

level.description: trace, debug, info, warning, error or fatal; commas for several

q.description: Text in the message, any case

to.description: An ISO time, or how long ago

name: search_logs
title: Search log lines
